**Sequence:** planner → architect (CHANGES-NEEDED; every ruling adopted, two with a recorded twist) → implement
(this block) → test-author → security-reviewer (two new routes) → verifier. Read first: `llm-conduct.md`,
`architecture.md` ("Read paths must not create", the principal-less-read precedents), `model-api.md` (foreign
`model` query fields take the record), design §21 as amended by P1-6, `PbRenderJobUtil`, `PbGraphUtil` run
API, `AsyncJobRegistry`, `RestServiceEventListener` boot/shutdown phases, `PbOrphanUtil.raw`.

**Architect rulings (substance; the review hand-back is in the session transcript, not reproduced verbatim):**

| # | Ruling | What P1-7 does about it |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Sweep PENDING runs as well as RUNNING — `submit` writes PENDING before the job is accepted | Done; distinct text and counter (⚠ §6.C item 62) |
| 2 | Reconcile a RUNNING **node** behind a non-RUNNING run (the `TestPbNodeRun.case07` shape) — sweep nodes independently of runs | Done: `rawRunningNodes` is a separate pass over `olio.pb.node.nodeStatus = RUNNING`, not a walk from runs |
| 3 | Principal-less raw reads are acceptable for a boot-only maintenance util provided the writes are re-authorized as a concrete user and the util is never request-reachable; **recommend a rules entry** naming that boundary | Reads raw, writes as each owner via `AccessPoint`; util is boot/test only. The rules recommendation goes to **Stephen** (⚠ §6.C item 63) — not applied |
| 4 | Never write as the org admin; skip and report what the owner cannot do | `denied` / `ownerUnresolved` counters + `problems[]`; nothing forced |
| 5 | A failing `persistLastRun` after acceptance must not 500 the submit (carried from P1-6 M1) | Already non-fatal (`lastRunUpdated:false`) |
| 6 | Resume = new run from the recorded execution set; do not reopen the INTERRUPTED run | `KIND_RESUME`, `PbRenderJobUtil.resume`, `resumedFromRunObjectId` (⚠ §6.C item 66) |
| 7 | Expose the run read so the Ux has a source of truth for "Resume" | `GET /{book}/run/{runId}` → `runDto` (⚠ §6.C item 68) |
| 8 | A graceful shutdown must not read as a user cancel (verifier L3): the worker must distinguish stop from cancel and write INTERRUPTED | `AsyncJobRegistry.beginShutdown()` raised first in `RestServiceEventListener.shutdown`; `shuttingDown()` checked at stage boundaries / lane wait / thrown stage; shutdown outranks cancel. **Twist:** `PbRenderLanes.acquire` also returns false on the flag so a queued job does not sit out the 5 s `awaitTermination` (⚠ §6.C item 65) |
| 9 | Scope the test sweep by workflow so the shared `pb2c-graph` residue is never swept by `runStatus` | `sweepInterrupted(BaseRecord workflow)` — record, not ids (⚠ §6.C item 67); tests assert by their own run ids |
| 10 | Exit criterion 2 ("restart → Resume") at the REST level in Phase 1; the Ux button is P1-10 | `e2e/pictureBookRestartRecovery.spec.js`, gated `PB_RESTART_TESTS=1`, ungraceful `docker restart -t 0` (⚠ §6.C item 69) |

**Candidate rules text (ruling 3), for Stephen — NOT applied to `.claude/rules/architecture.md`:**

> *Principal-less maintenance reads.* A raw `getSearch().findRecords` with no PBAC is permitted only in a
> utility that (1) runs at boot or from a test, never from a request path; (2) reads only to find records that
> need repair; (3) performs every write through `AccessPoint` as a concrete user who owns the record (never the
> org admin, never `RecordUtil`); and (4) reports, rather than forces, anything that user cannot do. Precedents:
> `PbOrphanUtil.raw`, `PbHealthUtil.java:1259`, `SetupUtil.java:817`, `PbRecoveryUtil` (P1-7).

round-trips, the spec parses every response body (§5.5 item 40). This is the kind of defect only a live-stack test
catches — the H2 contract test never serialises a run.

### 8.8 P1-8 — the `renderPath` switch (2026-10-11, planning 05:17–05:30 local; DONE 06:48 — architect CHANGES-NEEDED adopted, security PASS-WITH-NOTES, verifier PASS-WITH-NOTES)

**Sequence:** planner → architect (BEFORE implementation) → implement → test-author → security-reviewer (one new
read-only route) → verifier → re-create the test container with the new compose env → quick gate. Read first:
`llm-conduct.md`, `architecture.md` ("Config: DB-backed vs boot-pinned"; "No business logic in Service7"), design
§28.1, the P1-8/P1-9 task text, the `pb.render.sdPermits` plumbing (P1-6) end to end.

**Research before the planner (mine):** the `pb.render.sdPermits` key is the pattern to copy end to end
(`PbRenderLanes.CONFIG_KEY` → `RestServiceEventListener` :351–357 / `ConsoleMain` :130–134 → `WEB-INF/web.xml` :71 →
`docker/web.xml.template` :67–69 → `docker/entrypoint.sh` :47/:68/:107 → `docker-compose.yml` :55). The feature
manifest (`GET /rest/config/features/available`) is a static JSON **array** served verbatim and consumed as an array by
`featureConfig.js`, so a boot value cannot be spliced into it without a shape change. Book product is
`olio.pb.book.bookType` (`UNKNOWN` / `STORY` / `CHAPBOOK`; pre-ChapBook rows read SQL NULL). Service7 H2 tests
instantiate services directly with `HttpServletRequestMock`; routes taking `@Context ServletContext` evaluate
`resolveSdApiType/Server(context)` before the facade call, so the Service7 refusal test must use a request-only route.
Re-creating the test container (`docker-compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d am7`) is required for a new compose
env var and discards every prior `docker cp` (jar, classes, dist) — all must be re-copied, plus the template and
entrypoint (LF endings, chown/chmod) since those are baked into the image.

### 8.9 P1-9 — ChapBook on the Phase 1 path (2026-10-11, planning from 07:20 local)

**Orientation (read-only, while Objects7 gate run 4 holds `am7db`).** ChapBook scenes carry no `sceneNode` today
(the only writers are `PbPipelineUtil.dualWriteScene` `:853-871` during the PB graph build and `PbHealthUtil.java:823`
repair), so every ChapBook is refused by `requestSceneRender` (409 "has no graph node yet") and `requestRenderAll`
(409, no scene with a node). `createChapBook` (`ChapBookUtil.java:824-840`) already creates the workflow and one
non-executable `SCENE` node per scene (`cb-scene-<i>`, no scope, never linked to the scene). The v1 render
(`renderResolvedScene` `:1790-1966`) applies `fillStyleDefaults` / `applyConfigStyle` / default negativePrompt (G-25),
uses the SCENE as the `configOverride` carrier, resolves the prompt via `resolveScenePrompt` (promptLocked, LLM
recovery only with a chatConfig, explicit override verbatim) and writes `scene.imageObjectId`, which `bookPageView`
(`PbServiceFacade.java:1664-1666`) falls back to when there is no node. `PbNodeExecutor.executeLandscape`
(`:444-512`) has none of the G-25 calls, persists `ROLE_LANDSCAPE`, sets `DONE_UNVERIFIED` and never persists
`inputHash`. The test stack (`docker-compose.test.yml:269-270`) and the Objects7 test properties (`:51-52`) are both
`v3`/`v3`; production compose/entrypoint/Console7 stay `v1`. Ux752 `features/chapBook.js` never calls the bulk
`/render/{book}` route (only `e2e/chapbook-e2e-render.spec.js` and `e2e/chapBook.spec.js` do); it renders per scene via
`POST /scene/{id}/generate` and consumes the sync body `{imageObjectId, rendered, skipped, llmUnavailable, llmDegraded}`
(`:203-244`, `generateOne` `:1184-1219`). `AsyncJobRegistry` is a fixed pool of `MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS = 2` with
`MAX_ACTIVE_JOBS_PER_PRINCIPAL = 4`, and `PbRenderJobUtil` additionally takes a per-SD-server lane (`:589`).

**Planner (07:35 local) — summary of the plan handed to the architect.** (1) Lazy, idempotent "ensure graph" step at
the v3 render entry: one `LANDSCAPE` node per *prompted* ChapBook page (handle `PbPipelineUtil.landscapeHandle(sceneOid)`,
`scope=SCENE`, `scopeRef=scene.objectId`), legacy `cb-scene-*` nodes left in place, `scene.sceneNode` patched as in
`dualWriteScene`; no `CHAPBOOK_PAGE` enum value (LANDSCAPE is the Phase 1 seam). (2) Prompt pre-step stays in
`ChapBookUtil` exactly as v1 (promptLocked / override / LLM recovery with prior context) and persists a recovered prompt
to `scene.sdPrompt` before submit; a null prompt returns `{skipped:true, llmUnavailable:true}` with no node and no job.
Executor branch `executeChapBookPage` keyed on `bookType==CHAPBOOK` adds the G-25 calls, v1 `hiresOf`, image name
`chapbook_<oid>_<ts>`, `ROLE_LANDSCAPE` artifact, scene write-back `imageObjectId` + `imageStale=false`, and a
`completeNode(g, node, DONE_UNVERIFIED)` overload so the node gets `inputHash`/`lastRunAt`. Not carried on v3: the
per-request client `sdConfig` overlay (unhashable — P1-10 persists it as `scene.configOverride`), LLM calls inside the
job. (3) `imageStale` → node STALE by a direct `persistStatus(STALE)` from `mergeSceneUp` and the `PbHealthUtil`
dangling-image heal (`markSceneNodeStale`, never throws, no-op without a node); the executor clears `imageStale`.
(4) Branch in Objects7 (`renderChapBookScene` / `renderChapBookSummary` consult `PbRenderPath.isV3(book)`), Service7
`ChapBookService` untouched; the sync `/generate` body is kept and gains `renderPath, jobId, runObjectId, nodeObjectId,
artifactObjectId, nodeStatus, reviewStatus, autoApproveSkipReason`; a pinned page is the facade's 409. (5)
`bookPageView` resolves the selected artifact role from the node type (COMPOSITE → `composite`, LANDSCAPE →
`landscape`, default `composite`). (6) Review/auto-approve need nothing ChapBook-specific (`PbArtifactUtil`
`select:341`/`approve:367`/`autoApprove:425`/`reject:457` key on `(producedByNode, role)`). Tests: new
`TestChapBookV3Render` (ensure-graph idempotent; un-prompted → no node; live render → artifact row `role=landscape` +
`data` FK + selected, node `DONE_UNVERIFIED` + `inputHash`, scene `imageObjectId`/`imageStale=false`, `bookPageView`,
PNG opened; approve → APPROVED + pinned; auto-approve; merge-up → STALE → re-render; render-all (§6.C item 61 gap 1);
v1 default unchanged; pinned → 409), Service7 H2 `TestChapBookServiceRenderPath`, then redeploy + the ChapBook
Playwright suite on the v3 stack. Risks flagged: R1 `requireBookUpdate` on a ChapBook row; R2 nested-job deadlock on
the bulk route (`cb.render` wrapper awaiting inner `pb.render` on the 2-thread pool — I asked the architect whether
the v3 bulk path should submit one `pb.renderAll` job instead); R3 v1 regression; R4 `bookPageView` default role;
R5 `plan` 409 for current/pinned nodes; R6 `markSceneNodeStale` must never throw.

**Architect (07:55 local) — CHANGES-NEEDED, all adopted.** Three planner premises were wrong and are corrected before
implementation: (a) "v1 renders a recovered prompt without persisting it" — false, `renderResolvedScene` persists it at
`ChapBookUtil.java:1895-1916` (patch of `FIELD_CB_SD_PROMPT`, update result warned, non-fatal); the v3 pre-step must do the
same, not more. (b) "the executor reads `node.promptText`" — false, `executeLandscape` reads `scene.sdPrompt` through
`findSceneByNodeRef` (`PbNodeExecutor.java:978-1008`), so the ChapBook branch reads the scene too and `promptText` is a
mirror for the hash, not the prompt source. (c) "`imageStale=false` write-back is parity" — false, v1 never writes
`imageStale=false` anywhere; on v3 it is **new behaviour** and is recorded as a §5.5 deviation (it also weakens the §28.1
"rollback leaves data untouched" assumption: a v3-rendered page's `imageStale` is cleared where v1 would have left it).
Four design defects, each adopted as stated: **B1** a `cb.render` wrapper job that submits and awaits an inner
`pb.render`/`pb.renderAll` job deadlocks the fixed 2-thread `AsyncJobRegistry` pool as soon as two bulk renders overlap
(both wrappers hold the pool, both inner jobs queue forever) → the v3 bulk path runs the prompt pre-step for every scene
on the calling thread (continuity loop as v1), then submits **one** `pb.renderAll` through the facade; `ChapBookService`
`?async=true` on v3 returns that job's own `202 {jobId, runObjectId}` with no `cb.render` wrapper, branching only on an
Objects7-returned result that carries a `jobId` (transport stays logic-free). **B2** pre-marking a current `DONE` node
`STALE` so the planner will execute it fabricates staleness and contradicts P1-3 ("no STALE pre-mark") and §10 rule 3 →
an explicit `force` flag on `PbRenderJobUtil.submit`/`plan` bypasses only the `!EXECUTE_WHEN` reuse skip (`:376-379`);
the pinned skip (`:365-369`) and the facade's pinned 409 stay. **B3** scene edits must mark the node `STALE` at every
scene write site through a never-throwing `markSceneNodeStale(user, scene)` → `persistStatus(STALE)`; scene fields are
not folded into the generic `canonicalInput` (that is Phase 2's "hash watches `olio.pb.scene`", recorded in §6.C). The
write sites are `setSceneLandscapePrompt` (`:2059`, also re-mirrors `promptText`), `regenerateSceneLandscapePrompt`
(`:2127`, found during the code read — a fourth prompt writer the planner missed), `PbBookUtil.setSceneConfigOverride`
(`:796`, also re-mirrors `configOverride`), `mergeSceneUp` (`:1293`) and the `PbHealthUtil` dangling-image heal
(`:797-816`). **B4** the facade gates (`requireBook → requireV3 → requireBookUpdate → requireWorkflow →
requireSceneOfBook`) must run before the lazy node create / scene patch, so an unauthorised or v1 caller never writes.
Two candidate rules for Stephen (recorded in §6.C, **not** applied to `.claude/rules`): "an `AsyncJobRegistry` job must
never submit and await another registry job" and "a sync wrapper over an async job must bound its wait below the proxy
timeout and return job identifiers on timeout".

**Adopted design (implementation order).** Slice 1 (Objects7 plumbing): `PbRenderJobUtil` `force` flag + a public
`awaitTerminal(user, jobId, maxMs)` lifted from `TestPbRenderJob:1341`; `PbPipelineUtil.completeNode(g, node, status)`
overload (DONE delegate kept) and a `patchNodeScope` overload without a `SceneGraph`; `bookPageView` role from node type.
Slice 2: facade `requestChapBookSceneRender` / `requestChapBookRenderAll` (gates → ensure LANDSCAPE node, handle
`landscapeHandle(sceneOid)`, scope `SCENE`/`scene.objectId`/`sceneIndex`, mirror `sdPrompt → promptText` and
`configOverride → node.configOverride`, patch `scene.sceneNode` → submit with `force`) and `markSceneNodeStale` at the five
write sites. Slice 3: `PbNodeExecutor.executeChapBookPage` (LANDSCAPE dispatch when `bookType == CHAPBOOK`: G-25 style
calls, `hiresOf`, image name `chapbook_<oid>_<ts>`, `ROLE_LANDSCAPE` artifact + metrics, scene write-back
`imageObjectId` + `imageStale=false` as `g.user`, `completeNode(…, DONE_UNVERIFIED)`). Slice 4: `ChapBookUtil` v3 branches
in `renderChapBookScene` (pre-step → submit → bounded `awaitTerminal` → read node + selected artifact; on timeout a
202-shaped result with the job identifiers) and `renderChapBookSummary` (pre-step loop → one `pb.renderAll`), additive
fields on `SceneRenderResult` / `ChapBookRenderSummary`, Service7 pass-through + 202 on v3 bulk async. Slices 5–8: JUnit
(`TestChapBookV3Render` incl. render-all, closing §6.C item 61 gap 1), Service7 H2 contract, redeploy + ChapBook
Playwright on the v3 stack, docs.

**Implementation (08:10 → 09:27 local). Slices 1–4 DONE, both modules compile (`mvn -o -q -pl AccountManagerObjects7
compile`, `mvn -o -pl AccountManagerService7 compile` → `BUILD SUCCESS`).** What landed, by file:
- `PbRenderPath` (new): `V1`/`V3`, `PICTUREBOOK_CONFIG_KEY`/`CHAPBOOK_CONFIG_KEY`, `configure(pb, cb)`, `keyFor(book)` /
  `valueFor(book)` / `isV3(book)` / `requireV3(book)` (409 `render path is v1 …`). `BaseTest.setup()` re-pins both keys from
  `resource.properties:51-52` (`v3`/`v3`) on every `@Before` so a Phase 1 test can never silently run on the v1 default.
- `PbRenderJobUtil`: `force` flag on `submit`/`plan` (bypasses only the `!EXECUTE_WHEN` reuse skip; pinned skip and the
  facade's pinned 409 stay — B2); public `awaitTerminal(user, jobId, maxMs)`; `KIND_RENDER_ALL` honoured for ChapBook.
- `PbPipelineUtil`: `completeNode(g, node, status)` overload; `patchNodeScope` without a `SceneGraph`; `landscapeHandle`.
- `PbServiceFacade`: `requestChapBookPageRender` / `requestChapBookRenderAll` (public + package-private `SDUtil` seams);
  gates in B4 order (`requireBook → PbRenderPath.requireV3 → requireChapBook [403] → requireBookUpdate [403] →
  requireSceneOfBook`) **before** the lazy `ensureChapBookPageNode` (find by `landscapeHandle(sceneOid)` or `addNode(LANDSCAPE)`
  + `patchNodeScope` + `mirrorSceneOntoNode` + link `scene.sceneNode`); pinned → 409; DTO `sceneObjectId, sceneIndex,
  nodeObjectId` + the submit DTO (`KIND_RENDER`, `force=true`); render-all DTO `sceneCount`, `scenesWithoutPrompt`,
  `nodeObjectIds`, 409 when no page has a prompt. `bookPageView` resolves the artifact role from the node type.
- `PbNodeExecutor.executeChapBookPage` (LANDSCAPE dispatch when `bookType == CHAPBOOK`): G-25 `fillStyleDefaults` /
  `applyConfigStyle`, `hiresOf`, image name `chapbook_<sceneOid>_<ts>`, `ROLE_LANDSCAPE` artifact, scene write-back
  `imageObjectId` + `imageStale=false` as `g.user`, `completeNode(…, DONE_UNVERIFIED)`; empty SD result → 500 "SD backend
  returned no images for page <oid>" so the node goes FAILED rather than DONE with nothing.
- `PbBookUtil.markSceneNodeStale(user, scene)` (never throws, no-op without a node) at the five write sites named by B3;
  `ChapBookUtil` v3 branches in `renderChapBookScene` (pre-step → submit → bounded `awaitTerminal` → `v3PageResult`; on
  timeout a 202-shaped result with the job identifiers and `status=PENDING`) and `renderChapBookSummary` → one
  `pb.renderAll` (`submitChapBookRender`, null on v1); additive fields on `SceneRenderResult` (`renderPath, jobId,
  runObjectId, nodeObjectId, artifactObjectId, nodeStatus, reviewStatus, autoApproved, autoApproveSkipReason`) and
  `ChapBookRenderSummary` (`renderPath, jobId, runObjectId, failed, pending, plannedNodeCount`); `SceneRenderStatus.PENDING`.
  `ChapBookService` passes the fields through and, on v3 bulk `?async=true`, returns the `pb.renderAll` job's own 202
  (no `cb.render` wrapper — B1).

- Design, from the code (not memory — every route/verb/body re-read this session): A (gated `CB_LIVE_GEN`, SD) — page
  generate on v3 → 200/202 shape (`renderPath=v3`, `jobId`/`runObjectId`/`nodeObjectId`/`artifactObjectId`, `nodeStatus`,

  `artifacts.<role>[0]` is revision 1. The spec now asserts the measured order: `chain.map(a => a.revision)` `toEqual([1, 2])`,
  `chain[0]` = revision 1 (`selected:false`, `REJECTED`), `chain[1]` = revision 2 (`selected:true`). The stale comment is
  pre-existing P1-2/3 code, not P1-9 — recorded as §6.C 100, not fixed (scope discipline). P1-10 carry-forward: the Ux must
  never assume newest-first.

     ordered by id desc, limit 1. The `TestPbRenderJob` extension asserts the field is non-null after a submit (a null-tolerant assertion
     would pass forever).

     body and offers an explicit "Unpin and re-render" confirmation; only that confirmation sends `POST …/node/{n}/pin {pinned:false}`.

  (`PbGraphUtil.java:1147-1180`), bound records as the caller (`PbWatchedFields.readProjected:203-210`), unreadable → `undetermined`,

    (`PbGraphUtil.markRunning`, `:880` "Mutates the handle", `:901`). The test already accepts `jobStatus ∈ {queued, running}` one line
    earlier ("with a free pool the worker may already have started by the time the DTO is built", `:565-567`) but then asserted the
    run was still PENDING; on a warm DB the worker now reaches the stamp before the DTO is built. `persistLastRun` and the DTO shape
    are both in HEAD (`6985b41b`, 10:31) — `git diff HEAD` on `PbRenderJobUtil.java` is the one-line P1-10 force pass-through — so
    nothing in P1-9/P1-10 changed the timing; the window was always there. No Ux consumer reads the submit DTO's `runStatus`
    (`pictureBookWorkflow.js:135,148` map the `GET /run/{run}` DTO), and no Service7/Playwright test asserts PENDING at submit.

### 9.3.3 PF-1 re-find principal fix — new H2 JUnit `TestOlioServiceDeleteWorld`, red → green (2026-10-13 08:50 → 09:19 local)

**Defect (verifier note, §9.3.2 / §6.C 143a).** The 16:xx PF-1 recheck re-found the world **as the request user** after
`PbDeleteUtil.deleteBookComplete` step 2 had removed that user's per-book Writer/Admin roles, so a step-3 footprint failure read
as "gone" and the route answered `{"deleted":true}` for a world that still existed. **Fix (`OlioService.java:782-800`):** the
early return now requires the world to be absent for **both** `deleteAs` (the olio principal, owner of every Books-universe
world — its read never depended on the removed roles) **and** the request user (`worldGone(principal, objectId, orgId)`:
by-objectId find, `organizationId` condition, `setCache(false)`); otherwise the route falls through to
`WorldUtil.deleteWorld(deleteAs, world)` as before. `reset`'s `DeleteResult.reason`/`steps` are logged when it reports
`deleted=false` (`:764-767`). Refinement of 143a (which said "re-find as `deleteAs`" only): the user-side re-find is kept so
a world the olio principal cannot see but the user still can (not a product shape today — every world is olio-created,
`OlioContext.java:854/867`, `WorldUtil.java:472/477`) is never reported deleted; recorded as §6.C 144a.

**Fixture (`TestOlioServiceDeleteWorld`, Service7 H2 harness `BaseTest`).** Mirrors the production Olio bootstrap
(`OlioContext.configureEnvironment` `:798-810`): the org admin creates `/Olio` (DATA group) and grants `olioUser`
`Read/Update/Create` on it for `DATA`+`GROUP`; `olioUser` then creates `/Olio/Universes`; worlds are created **as `olioUser`**
with `WorldUtil.getCreateWorld` (as production does); a book world additionally gets an `olio.pb.book` (`DRAFT`/`STORY`,
`createdByObjectId` = the test user) under `PbBookUtil.bookGroupPath(slug)`, the per-book Writer role
(`PbOlioContextUtil.writerRolePath(slug)`) with the test user enrolled and `Read/Update/Create/Delete` on the book group plus
`Read` on the world — the shape `configureWorldAuthorization` gives a real book. The admin is used for fixture bootstrap only;
every route call is made as `deleteworlduser` through the real `OlioService.deleteWorld(ServletContext, HttpServletRequest,
objectId)` with the request/context injected as in `TestOlioServiceReimageNotFound`. Four cases:

against `WebAuthnService.java`, `AM7LoginModule.java`, `webauthnCredentialModel.json` and `RecordUtil.getRecordByQuery`:
1. Low — `WebAuthnService.java:347-349`: `orgPath` falls back to the client DTO's `organizationPath` when the owner record lacks
   the virtual field; `AM7LoginModule.java:128-137` resolves the `${jwt}` subject **by name in that org**. Derive the org from
   `owner.organizationId`, never from the DTO.
2. Low — `request.login()` on an already-authenticated session throws `ServletException` (swallowed, `:350-352`): user B gets
   200 + JWT while the session stays user A. Invalidate first, or fail closed.
3. Low — no test for `POST /auth` with no pending session challenge (`:261-262`); the challenge has no server-side TTL.
4. Low, pre-existing — `RP_ID = "localhost"` (`:61`) is now a hard failure on any other host via `rpIdHash`;
   `findCredentialById` (`:429-438`) has no `organizationId` condition.
5. Info — registration stores `origin` from the `Origin` header (`:183`) without comparing it to `clientData.origin`.
Deliberate tightenings it confirmed: an empty `publicKey` (the `am7client.js:813` fallback) is now 400 instead of a silently
stored useless row; origin is enforced, so a key registered at `:9443` will not log in through the `:8899` Vite proxy. Caveat it
raised: all four PF-5 Maven logs say `Nothing to compile` (classes came from the JDT language server); the timeline is
consistent (source 10:58:00.70 → class 10:58:01.32 → green run) and the PF-5b red-first above re-proves the point.

**Security-reviewer — PASS** (no blocking issue; crypto, checks, challenge handling, public-surface exposure, counter
persistence, ownership and test genuineness all clean). Two MEDIUM hardening items, both pre-existing shape rather than
introduced by PF-5b, verified here against the code and recorded in §9.5:
- **Cross-org `credentialId` collision (DoS, not takeover):** `webauthnCredentialModel.json:9` is unique per
  `(credentialId, organizationId)`, `credentialId` is client-supplied at registration, and `findCredentialById` returns
  `results[0]` of a credentialId-only query (`RecordUtil.getRecordByQuery`, undefined order). A user in another org who registers
  a victim's credentialId (public via `GET /auth`) can make the victim's genuine assertion fail on `signature` and their `DELETE`
  403. Fix: org-scope the lookup (or make the constraint global) and validate `credentialId` as base64url at registration (it is
  also interpolated unescaped into hand-built JSON).
- **Client-supplied `organizationPath` can select the JAAS org** — the same site as verifier finding 1; not reachable today
  because `PathProvider` populates `organizationPath` on every read (`RecordReader.java:248-252`), so it fires only if the
  provider throws. Fix: drop the fallback and fail closed; have `AM7LoginModule` compare the token's org claim to `orgPath`.
Low/Info: registration does not validate `clientData.origin` (stores the `Origin` header; `CorsFilter` mitigates); `POST /auth`
does not bind to the user named in `GET /auth?user=` (the owner comes from the credential and the signer must hold the key —
no bypass); `RP_ID` hard-coded; EC curve / RSA size not checked (self-harm only); `GET /auth` creates a session per anonymous
call; the service uses `RecordUtil` directly (pre-existing) with an explicit ownership check at `:395-399`; a Console7-side
delete can leave `findCredentialById` cached for up to 6 min.

**Row status:** PF-5b **DONE — LANDED (live)**; PF-5c **DONE — LANDED (live)**; PF-5 closed by them. Nothing committed.

**Answers to the five questions.**
1. **Root cause, not assertion-side.** All four closings (`PbNodeExecutor.java:512-513, 684-685, 779-780, 908-909`) now go through
   `PbPipelineUtil.completeNode`, matching the ChapBook page (`:637-638`) and portrait (`:1026`). `executeLandscape` (`:445-516`) has
   exactly one success exit; every other exit throws, and the three wrappers all route to `PbPipelineUtil.failNode`
   (`executeNode :190`, `executeNodeRun :247-248` + `closeRun FAILED`, `executeStage :294`); `PbStageCancelledException` is rethrown
   untouched by design (`:290-291`).
2. **No double-marking, no double-count.** `completeNode` (`PbPipelineUtil.java:728-746`) is the only STALE writer (`:740`) and the
   only `g.executed++` (`:741`). The caller's `downstreamOf` (`PbGraphUtil.java:1026`) is write-free and feeds only `artifactDto`
   (`:1077-1082`) — a second BFS read, not a second write pass.
3. **case11 is genuine** (`TestPbRenderJob.java:1164-1292`): drives the real `PbRenderJobUtil.submit` + `AsyncJobRegistry` job twice
   on live Swarm, asserts on persisted rows re-read via `PbGraphUtil.readNode`/`readRun`/`PbArtifactUtil.readArtifact`, checks PNG
   magic on the stored bytes; user `testUser1` (`:1296-1302`; admin only as creator-principal, the standard idiom). The 20-min
   `@Test(timeout)` and `awaitTerminal` deadline are liveness guards shared by every case, not speed thresholds.
4. **`pictureBookV3PlainPb.spec.js`** (not run): `ensureSharedTestUser` (`:34, :202`), credential built only from its return
   (`:49-61`); WebSocket stub in `addInitScript` before `goto` (`:73-93`); `/chapter`-created fixture with `bookType` asserted
   `STORY` (`:218`) so LANDSCAPE dispatches to `executeLandscape` (`PbNodeExecutor.java:425`). Prior run evidence is real:
   `C:/tmp/pw-pf9-rest.log` (Oct 12 20:12) `4 passed (1.1m)` with the 409 lines; all three PNGs exist in `test-results/pf9-plain/`
   at the cited sizes.
5. **No fake tests.** `TestWebAuthnUtil` uses real `KeyPairGenerator` (secp256r1, RSA-2048) and real `Signature`; each negative case
   re-signs the tampered artifact so only the targeted check fails (`:150-185`). `WebAuthnUtil.java` imports only `java.security`,

### 10.2 P2-2 plan — `ModelResolver`, installed-model inventory, models-by-task route (planned 2026-10-13 15:45; Objects7 + Service7)

**Scope.** Objects7 `olio.illustration` gains the §16 resolver as pure functions over plain values, a Swarm-backed
installed-model inventory with a 5-minute per-server cache, the `taskModels` key↔enum mapping, the task→family support
rule, and the one-place mode→strategy mapping (§6.C 150 d). `PbServiceFacade` gains one read-only method; `PictureBookService`
gains one thin GET. **No schema change.** Left to later tasks: wiring reimage/chat/PB callers through the resolver (P2-3),
`RenderPlan`/estimate/strategy *selection* (P2-4), the 4xx mapping of an unresolved result (P2-5). Planned under the gate-run-7
embargo: nothing was run; every citation is from a file read.

**Files.**
- `olio/illustration/ModelInventory.java` — `interface { String server(); List<String> installedModels(); long fetchedAt(); String error(); }`.
- `olio/illustration/SwarmModelInventory.java` — `static ModelInventory forServer(SDAPIEnumType type, String server)`,
  `static void invalidate(String server)`, `invalidateAll()`, `TTL_MS = 300_000`. Backed by the existing
  `new SDUtil(type, server).listModels()` (`SDUtil.java:238-264`, `POST /API/ListModels`, `path:""`, `depth:2`). Cache: a private
  static `ConcurrentHashMap<server, Snapshot{names, fetchedAt}>` inside this class — nothing added to `IOContext`; the server
  URL is a per-call parameter. A fetch that throws or returns null is **not cached** (an outage must not pin "nothing installed"
  for five minutes); it yields an empty list plus `error()`. Non-SWARM `type` → empty list, `error = "inventory unsupported for <type>"`.
  Invalidation = TTL + explicit `invalidate`; **cross-JVM bound is the TTL** (Console7 / a second Service7 cannot evict it).
- `olio/illustration/CheckpointNames.java` — `static String matchInstalled(List<String> installed, String candidate)` → the listed
  name or null: full name `equalsIgnoreCase`, then both sides with `.safetensors` stripped, then the basename after the last `/`.
  Mirrors `SdTestGate.isInstalled` (`SdTestGate.java:191-200`) and `RendererCapabilities.matches` (`:120-133`).
- `olio/illustration/ModelTaskKeys.java` — `key(PbModelTaskEnumType)` (`PORTRAIT→portrait`, `SCENE_DIRECT→sceneDirect`, …),
  `task(String)` (canonical lower-camel first, then the enum name, both case-insensitive, else `UNKNOWN`),
  `parseTaskModels(String json)` → `Map<PbModelTaskEnumType,String>` via `JSONUtil.getMap`, dropping values that fail
  `NarrativeUtil.isMeaningful` (`NarrativeUtil.java:2079`: null/blank/`"null"`/`n/a`/`none`/`unknown`/`unspecified`),
  log-and-skip unknown keys; null/blank/malformed → empty map; never throws.
- `olio/illustration/ModelResolver.java` — pure, final, no DB/SD/picturebook imports. Value types are **final classes, not
  `record`s** (§6.C 151 e): `Step {OVERRIDE, STYLE_TASK, STYLE_DEFAULT, DEPLOYMENT_DEFAULT}`; `Reason {OK, NOT_INSTALLED,
  FAMILY_UNKNOWN, FAMILY_DISABLED, FAMILY_UNSUPPORTED_FOR_TASK, NO_CANDIDATE}`; `Candidate(step, requested, listedName, family,
  reason)`; `Request(task, override, taskModels, styleModel, styleFlux2Model, deploymentModel, deploymentFlux2Model,
  referencesRequested)` (builder); `Resolution(task, model, family, step, degraded, degradationCode, degradationText,
  candidates)` with `isResolved()`. `static Resolution resolve(Request, List<String> installed)` walks §16's four steps in
  order; each candidate must (a) match `installed` via `CheckpointNames`, (b) have `RendererCapabilities.forModel(listed) != null`,
  (c) `isEnabled()`, (d) pass `supportsTask`; the first pass wins and `model` is the **listed** name.
  `static Reason supportsTask(RendererCapabilities, PbModelTaskEnumType, boolean referencesRequested)`;
  `static PbStrategyEnumType strategyForMode(String compositeMode)` (`flux2→DIRECT_REFERENCE`, `classic→CLASSIC_COMPOSITE`,
  `kontext`/null/other → `UNKNOWN`); `static String degradationText(Resolution)` in §16 :882's form
  (`"<requested> not installed; using <step> → <listed>"`).
- `olio/illustration/DeploymentModelDefaults.java` — the single impure helper: `static Defaults current()` =
  `(SDUtil.getDefaultModel(), SWUtil.defaultFlux2Model())` (`SDUtil.java:1910`, `SWUtil.java:138`). Keeps `resolve` pure;
  P2-3 passes the values in.
- `olio/picturebook/PbServiceFacade.java` — `public static Map<String,Object> listModelsForTask(BaseRecord user, String task,
  String sdApiType, String sdServer, String styleObjectId)`: 401 on null user (pattern `:78-85`), 400 on
  `ModelTaskKeys.task()==UNKNOWN`, **500** on blank `sdServer` and on an unrecognised `sdApiType` (both are deployment
  config, not caller input — security correction, §6.C 155 a; the plan said 400); optional style via `PbStyleUtil.readStyle`
  (PBAC-authorized; null → 404). Returns `{task, inventory:{fetchedAt, error, count}, deploymentDefault:{model, flux2Model},
  resolution:{model, family, step, reason, degraded, degradationCode, degradationText, inventoryFetchedAt, inventoryError,
  candidates:[{step, requested, listedName, family, reason}]}, models:[{listedName, family, enabled, supportedForTask, reason}]}`
  — no `server` key: the SD server URL does not reach a `user`-role caller (§6.C 155 a). Nothing is written.
- `rest/services/PictureBookService.java` — `@RolesAllowed({"admin","user"}) @GET @Path("/models") @Produces(JSON)
  listModels(@QueryParam("task"), @QueryParam("style"), @Context HttpServletRequest, @Context ServletContext)` →
  `PbServiceFacade.listModelsForTask(user, task, resolveSdApiType(context), resolveSdServer(context), style)`

**Decisions.**
1. ✓ Resolver takes plain values, no `BaseRecord`, never throws — the brief's "pure functions at the seams"; §31 :1446-1483.
2. ✓ Inventory wraps the existing `SDUtil.listModels()`; no second Swarm client (`SDUtil.java:238`; §15 :860-862;
   `SdTestGate.java:142-143` already does exactly this).
3. ✓ Cache keyed by server URL in `SwarmModelInventory`, 5-min TTL (§16 :880), explicit `invalidate(server)`, failed fetches
   uncached; nothing in `IOContext` (architecture: per-call config travels with the call).
4. ✓ Name matching full → extension-stripped → basename, case-insensitive, with `.safetensors` stripped on **both** sides at
   every step (so the Docker `sd.model` spelling `juggernautXL_ragnarokBy.safetensors` matches `SDXL/juggernautXL_ragnarokBy.safetensors`);
   this is **looser** than `SdTestGate.isInstalled` (`:191-200`, which never basename-matches) — a basename that matches more
   than one folder is logged and the first listed wins (architect correction 5, 16:00). ⚠ `Resolution.model` is the
   **listed** (folder + extension) form, not the requested spelling: it is what the server accepts and sidesteps the
   `.safetensors` question (memory: Swarm names need the extension); P2-3 decides what gets persisted and must not re-strip it.
   **Refined 17:26 while implementing (⚠ §6.C 154 a):** the basename step applies **only to a candidate that names no folder of
   its own**. `juggernautXL_ragnarokBy` → `SDXL/juggernautXL_ragnarokBy.safetensors` still matches; `other/juggernautXL_ragnarokBy`
   against the same listing is `NOT_INSTALLED`, not a silent substitution of a same-named file from another folder. The pure test
   `matchesFolderAndExtension` asserted the stricter rule and the first implementation matched by basename on both sides; the
   implementation was corrected, not the test.
5. ✓ `taskModels` keys are §16's lower-camel names (`styleModel.json:43`, `PbModelTaskEnumType` javadoc). ⚠ Enum-name keys
   (`"PORTRAIT"`) are tolerated on read; write-side canonicalization is P2-3's. `TestPbStyleSchema.case01`'s fixture string was
   changed to the canonical keys (15:46) so P2-1 and P2-2 do not drift.
6. ✓ Step 3 style default: SDXL-family tasks → `sdConfig.model` (`configModel.json:71-74`); `SCENE_DIRECT` → `sdConfig.flux2Model`
   (`:325-328`) — §16 :876.
7. ⚠ **Deployment default (step 4) — for Stephen.** Proposed: `SDUtil.getDefaultModel()` for SDXL-family tasks (boot-pinned
   `sd.default.model` → `sd.model` via `RestServiceEventListener.java:328-337`, else the schema default
   `OfficialStableDiffusion/sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors`, `configModel.json:71-74`) and `SWUtil.defaultFlux2Model()` for
   `SCENE_DIRECT` (schema `flux2Klein_9b`). No new `/System` record; the resolver does not extend `ServerConfigUtil` (§16 :885-893
   offers "a `/System` config record **or** one init-param block" — the init-param block already exists and is boot-pinned, the
   record would be a new DB-backed config with its own refresh story). **Consequence, corrected 16:00 (architect correction 2 —
   the 15:45 text wrongly said `sd_xl_base_1.0` is absent on .39):** §36.1 :1722 lists `sd_xl_base_1.0` as **installed**, and in
   the Docker stack a blank `SD_DEFAULT_MODEL` (`docker-compose.yml:49`) falls back to `sd.model` =
   `juggernautXL_ragnarokBy.safetensors` (`RestServiceEventListener.java:328-337`, `web.xml.template:165-166`), which is installed.
   A style-less SDXL task ends `NO_CANDIDATE` only when both init-params are blank **and** the schema default is absent from the
   inventory — the design's hard-fail, surfaced honestly when it happens. The honest propagation bound is a **restart**:
   `DeploymentModelDefaults.current()` re-reads `SDUtil.getDefaultModel()` (`volatile`, set once at boot, `SDUtil.java:1896-1914`),
   so the DTO/javadoc say so. Architect: ADOPT on the corrected premise.
8. ✓ Task→family rule from `capabilities.json` flags only: `PORTRAIT`/`LOCATION` any enabled family; `SCENE_DIRECT` needs
   `supportsReferences` when `referencesRequested`, else any enabled; `INPAINT` needs `supportsMasks`; `HARMONIZE` needs
   `supportsInitImage`. ⚠ `UPSCALE` = any enabled family — `capabilities.json` has no upscale flag.
9. ✓ Kontext: `forModel` returns the `*kontext*` family with `isEnabled()==false` → `FAMILY_DISABLED`, refused at every step
   **including an explicit override** (§34 retire; §37.3). Unknown family (null from `forModel`) → `FAMILY_UNKNOWN`.
10. ✓ Degradation: a rejected earlier candidate followed by a later success → `degraded=true`,
    `degradationCode="MODEL_SUBSTITUTED"` (§19 :976), text per §16 :882. All steps exhausted → `isResolved()==false`, last
    candidate `NO_CANDIDATE`; P2-5 turns that into the 4xx.
11. ✓ Mode→strategy lives in `ModelResolver.strategyForMode` only; `SceneCompositeUtil.MODE_*` (`:34-39`) stays the storage
    vocabulary (§6.C 150 d). Strategy *selection* (e.g. the `SEQUENTIAL_INPAINT` fallback) is P2-4's.
12. ✓ **Route path — resolved 16:00 to the design.** The 15:45 plan proposed `GET /olio/picture-book/models?task=&style=` on
    `PictureBookService` (every PB route is under `@Path("/olio/picture-book")`, `PictureBookService.java:129`;
    `resolveSdServer`/`resolveSdApiType` live there, `:747-758`; `TestPictureBookRestContract` reflectively enforces
    `@RolesAllowed` there, `:100-138`). The architect ESCALATED, recommending §27 :1318 verbatim: the resolver is product-agnostic
    (§2 :86, §16 :894 — reimage and chat callers would otherwise hit a `picture-book` URL, the §6.C 150 a branding concern), and
    the two resolver helpers are one-liners to hoist. **Taken: `GET /olio/illustration/models?task=&style=` on a new Service7
    `IllustrationService` (`@Path("/olio/illustration")`, `@RolesAllowed({"admin","user"})`), with its own reflective
    contract test `TestIllustrationRestContract` (same shape as `TestPictureBookRestContract:100-138`), calling the same
    `PbServiceFacade.listModelsForTask`.** The brief points the task at §27 ("GET …/models-by-task route (§16, §18, §27)"), so
    this is the instruction, not a judgement; the `picture-book` variant is one method to move if Stephen prefers it (§6.C 152 a).
13. ✓ The route reads no book; the optional style is read through PBAC. No business logic in Service7.

**Seams for P2-3 / P2-4 / P2-5.** P2-3 builds `ModelResolver.Request` from the resolved style chain
(`ModelTaskKeys.parseTaskModels(style.taskModels)`, `sdConfig.model`, `sdConfig.flux2Model`, `DeploymentModelDefaults.current()`),
canonicalizes `taskModels` keys on write, and calls `SwarmModelInventory.forServer(sdApiType, sdServer).installedModels()` with
the per-call server from `resolveSdServer`. P2-4 reads `Resolution.family` for `recommendedSteps`/cfg/resolutions,
`strategyForMode(compositeMode)` as the entry strategy, `degraded`/`degradationCode` into the plan's degradation list and
`candidates` as the audit trail; `secondsPerStepPerReference` stays null until measured. P2-5 maps `!isResolved()` → 4xx using
`candidates[*].reason`, and `inventory.error` → an upstream-unavailable status.

**Risks / unknowns (corrected 16:00).** (1) ~~The deployment default `sd_xl_base_1.0` is absent on .39~~ — wrong; it is installed
(§36.1 :1722) and the Docker stack falls back to `sd.model` = `juggernautXL_ragnarokBy.safetensors` (decision 7, corrected). The
real risk is a deployment with both init-params blank and a schema default the server lacks. (2) `listModels` uses `depth:2`;
checkpoints nested deeper read as "not installed". (3) **MUST (architect correction 1):** `SDUtil.listModels()` never throws and
never returns null — null session (`SDUtil.java:242-244`), null response (`:252`) and any exception (`:260-262`) all return an
empty list — so through that call an outage is indistinguishable from an empty inventory and the 15:45 "failed fetch is not
cached" claim was unimplementable; under P2-5 it would have turned a Swarm hiccup into five minutes of 4xx on every render.
Taken: a new failure-distinguishing `SDUtil.listModelsOrNull()` (null on no-session / null-response / transport failure; the
existing `listModels()` untouched for its callers), `SwarmModelInventory` caches only a non-null answer (an empty list from a
successful call **is** cached — it is a real answer; whether `.39` ever returns an empty `files` on a live session is confirmed in
the live JUnit), and `ModelResolver.Reason` gains `INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE` so a `Resolution` says "renderer unavailable" (§20
:991), never "model missing", when the inventory could not be read. (4) `SDUtil`'s static session cache (`:157-165`) is per
server URL; after a Swarm restart the first `listModelsOrNull` fails (null → uncached, `error` set) and the next call re-fetches —
no "nothing installed" window. (5) Whether render callers need the `.safetensors` form is sidestepped by returning the listed
name; P2-3 must not re-strip it. (6) `test.swarm.model` is empty in `resource.properties:73`; the live test depends on
`resolveInstalledCheckpoints` filling it — which `BaseTest.setup()` already does (`BaseTest.java:106-107`), so the planned
`@Before` call is redundant and dropped.

**Architect review (2026-10-13 16:00; read-only, embargoed from Maven/DB/SD/LLM/Docker/network) — PASS WITH CORRECTIONS;
every citation re-verified by me against the files before adoption.** Verdict: layering clean (Service7 method = principal +
`resolveSdApiType/resolveSdServer` + one facade call + `handlePictureBookException`, same as `listStale` `:1312-1325`); the only AM7
read is `PbStyleUtil.readStyle` → `AccessPoint.find`, no writes in the call graph; the inventory fetch is already a `user`-role
surface today (`OlioService.listSDModels`, `@RolesAllowed({"user"})`, `OlioService.java:147-158`, same uncached
`SDUtil.listModels()`), so the route adds no exposure and the cache reduces amplification; a static per-server-URL cache is
acceptable under "per-org config must never be written to process-global state" because the SD URL is deployment-global
(`ServerConfigUtil.java:42-59`), the key travels with the call, and `SDUtil.sessionCache` / `ServerConfigUtil.cache` are the
existing shape; a Swarm session is remote renderer state, not an AM7 record, so "read paths must not create" is not engaged;
nothing in this JVM installs checkpoints (§36.5), so TTL + explicit `invalidate` is the correct and only bound and the cross-JVM
bound (TTL) is stated honestly. Corrections and disposition: **1 MUST** (uncacheable failure through `listModels()`) — adopted,
risk (3) above. **2** (decision 7 premise) — adopted, decision 7 rewritten. **3** (`Resolution` loses inventory provenance) —
adopted: `resolve(Request, ModelInventory)` is the primary entry and `resolve(Request, List<String>)` wraps the list in an
in-memory inventory for the pure tests; `Resolution` carries `inventoryFetchedAt` / `inventoryError`; `Candidate` carries the
`RendererCapabilities` object (nullable) so P2-4 does not re-run `forModel`. **4** (step 3 needs a second authorized read:
`styleRequest()` projects `sdConfig` as an id reference, `PbStyleUtil.java:46-48`, and `olio.sd.config`'s common fields carry no
`model`/`flux2Model`, `configModel.json:4`) — adopted: `PbStyleUtil.readSdConfigModels(user, style)` reads the referenced
`olio.sd.config` by id through `AccessPoint.find` with `request [id, objectId, model, flux2Model]` (null when the style has none or
the caller may not read it — then step 3 is simply absent); P2-3's chain resolver reuses it. **5** (basename matching both sides;
`SdTestGate.isInstalled` does not basename-match) — adopted, decision 4 rewritten, test case added. **6** (`PbServiceFacade` javadoc
invariant "every entry point starts from a book objectId", `:40-47`, breaks) — adopted: an explicit carve-out paragraph in that
javadoc ("bookless entry point: `listModelsForTask`; its root is the optional style, authorized by identity through
`AccessPoint.find`; it reads no book and writes nothing"); it stays in `PbServiceFacade` because `olio.illustration` may not
import `PbStyleUtil` (§6.C 150 a) and a second facade is an abstraction the task does not need. **7** (`sdApiType` conversion:
`PbNodeExecutor.toSdUtil` `:128-133` does `SDAPIEnumType.valueOf`, throws on junk; blank `sdServer` is a 500 by the facade's own
contract, `PbServiceFacade.java:407`) — adopted: null/blank → `PictureBookException(500, "SD server is not configured")`,
`IllegalArgumentException` → 500 with the value named; `?task=` junk stays 400. **8** (do not return the SD server URL to
`user`-role callers; `/olio/sdModels` does not) — adopted: the wire DTO carries `inventory:{fetchedAt,error,count}` and no `server`;
security-reviewer confirms at P2-2's review. **9** (tests) — adopted: `anyListedKontextIsFamilyDisabled` uses `Assume` to skip
visibly when no Kontext checkpoint is listed; the TTL test asserts snapshot identity (same object within the TTL, different after
`invalidate`) and never compares `fetchedAt` millis; the `@Before` gate call is dropped (`BaseTest.setup()` does it);
`TestIllustrationRestContract`'s annotation test is acceptable only beside the live facade JUnit, which is in the plan; and the
Ux note that `JSONUtil` is `NON_EMPTY`, so `candidates: []` and a null `error` vanish from the wire. ⚠ decisions: 4 ADOPT, 5
ADOPT, 7 ADOPT (corrected premise; "restart" bound stated), 8 ADOPT (no `supportsUpscale` flag in `capabilities.json`;
`refinerupscale` works on any checkpoint, §15 :843; add the flag when P2-4 fixes the UPSCALE mechanism and name the absence in the

### 10.3 P2-3 plan — style inheritance + lock resolution, `/style` routes, one model policy per caller (planned 2026-10-13 18:00; Objects7 + Service7)

**Scope.** Every image-producing caller — `OlioService` reimage ×6, `ChatService` scene + landscape pass, PB1 portrait,
`PbNodeExecutor` ×4 — chooses its checkpoint through one Objects7 entry point that runs P2-2's `ModelResolver` against
`SwarmModelInventory`, fed by the book's **effective style** (book → parent chain → series → series' parents → library →
none), and writes the pick into a per-call config copy only (§4.1 "the generation path never persists config"). A book's
own style is readable, writable and lockable at `/olio/picture-book/{book}/style`. Design: §4, §4.1, §16, §27, §28.1, §34;
ratified P2-1 defaults §6.C 149; every ⚠ of this plan is **§6.C 156**. ChapBook v1 is out (156 k); no Ux change (P2-9).

**Files.**
- NEW `olio/picturebook/PbStyleResolver.java` — `EffectiveStyle resolve(BaseRecord user, BaseRecord book)`: pure read as the
  caller, nothing written, nothing thrown. Walk: `book.style` (projected by `PbBookUtil.bookRequest()` `:1168-1180`) → its
  `parent` chain → `book.series.style` (`PbSeriesUtil.readSeries` `:223`, `seriesRequest()` `:552-558` projects `style`) →
  its parent chain → LIBRARY (156 c) → none; `MAX_DEPTH = 8` hops, visited-`objectId` cycle guard; every hop read with
  `PbStyleUtil.readStyle` `:77-86` (an unreadable hop ends the walk and sets `truncatedAt`). Per-field **nearest-set-wins**:
  strings via `NarrativeUtil.isMeaningful`, enums present and ≠ `UNKNOWN`, `customWidth/Height > 0`, `sdConfig` FK `id > 0`
  (nearest whole, 156 b), `taskModels` per key (156 a); `photoreal` is a BOOLEAN column with DDL `default false`, so "unset" is
  unobservable and the child always wins (documented limitation). Exposes `chain()`, `value(field)`/`source(field)`,
  `taskModels()`, `sdConfig()` (the nearest hop's config read **fully** as the caller, new `PbStyleUtil.readSdConfig`),
  `lockedBy()`, `truncatedAt()`, `cycleDetected()`, `isComplete()`, `qualityPreset()`/`pageFormat()` with the §29 fallback
  constants (156 l), `isStyleField(name)` (the §4.1 set), and `canonicalStyle()` — the `style=` hash component (156 g).
- NEW `olio/illustration/IllustrationModelPolicy.java` — product-agnostic: `Resolution apply(PbModelTaskEnumType task,
  BaseRecord sdConfigCopy, String override, Map<PbModelTaskEnumType,String> taskModels, String styleModel, String
  styleFlux2Model, SDAPIEnumType sdApiType, String sdServer, boolean referencesRequested)` — builds `ModelResolver.Request`
  exactly as `PbServiceFacade.listModelsForTask` does, resolves against `SwarmModelInventory.forServer` +
  `DeploymentModelDefaults.current()`, writes the pick (or the deployment default when unresolved, 156 f) into the copy's
  `flux2Model` for SCENE_DIRECT else `model` by string field name; accepts a null copy (resolves, writes nothing). Never
  touches `IOContext`; never persists.
- NEW `olio/picturebook/PbModelPolicy.java` — `applyForBook(user, book, task, cfgCopy, override, sdApiType, sdServer,
  refs)` = `PbStyleResolver.resolve` → flatten (`taskModels`, `sdConfig.model/flux2Model`) → `IllustrationModelPolicy`;
  `applyForStyle(user, style, …)` for the already-resolved executor path; `applyWithoutBook(…)` for non-PB callers (no pins).
- `PbConfigUtil` — style-aware overloads `resolveDeclaredConfig(book, node, composite, EffectiveStyle)` /
  `resolveEffectiveConfig(book, node, composite, clientOverlay, EffectiveStyle)`; `mergeTiers` takes the style's `sdConfig`
  as the book tier when present (156 b). The 3-arg/4-arg forms delegate with a null style and say so in their javadoc.
- `PbGraphUtil` — `canonicalInput(user, node, book, bindings, style)` + `computeInputHash(…, style)` +
  `recomputeStatus(…, style)`; old signatures delegate with a fresh `PbStyleResolver.resolve` (156 h); `style=` component
  only when the chain is non-empty (156 g).
- `PbStaleUtil.compute` — one `resolve` per scan threaded into every node; truncated/cyclic ⇒ `complete=false` + nodes
  `undetermined` (156 h).
- `PbNodeExecutor` `:473` (LANDSCAPE → LOCATION), `:577` (ChapBook page → LOCATION), `:867` (COMPOSITE → SCENE_DIRECT when

  the one authorized write: no `book.style` → `RecordFactory.newInstance(MODEL_PB_STYLE)` named `<slug>-style` in

  (model-api.md); `PbStaleUtil.touchBook` `:505-521` after either write. `lockStyle(user, bookOid, locked)` (403 → 404 no
  own style → `patchOf(style, …, FIELD_PB_LOCKED)`). Clearing `book.style` to null is through the generic `PATCH /rest/model`

- `rest/services/PictureBookService.java` — `GET /{bookObjectId}/style`, `PUT /{bookObjectId}/style`,

  `:216`; `TestPictureBookRestContract` expected list `:148-186` extended.

**Decisions.** (1) `PbStyleResolver` separate from `PbStyleUtil` — ✓ its javadoc `:22-25`, ⚠ 156 i. (2) nearest-set-wins per
field with `isMeaningful` as "set" — ✓ §4.1. (3) `taskModels` per key — ⚠ 156 a. (4) `sdConfig` nearest-whole, values as the
book tier replacing the legacy book config — ⚠ 156 b (architect correction 2 adopted). (5) LIBRARY = `/Library/PictureBookStyles`,
find-only, group-constrained, re-read per hit — ⚠ 156 c (correction 3 adopted). (6) lock = write refusal + pure `lockedBy`,
never a pin — ✓ §4.1. (7) locked PUT 409, including a locked ancestor — ⚠ 156 d. (8) style in `inputHash` via the config tier +
a non-config `style=` component only when a chain exists; runtime pick never hashed — ⚠ 156 g. (9) policy at the caller seam,
`SDUtil` copies `model` in two methods — ✓ exit criterion "one model policy". (10) task mapping — ⚠ 156 e (correction 7
adopted). (11) `!isResolved()` → deployment default + WARN — ⚠ 156 f (correction 1 adopted). (12) `series.style` olio-principal
only — ✓ 151 h. (13) once-per-scan chain, truncated ⇒ incomplete scan — ⚠ 156 h (corrections 4 and 11 adopted). (14) the
rule-gap one-liner recorded only — 156 j.
